articles.title: LeBron James makes a statement at 76ers Media Day with one simple joke
articles.summary: LeBron James already looked right at home in Philadelphia during his first media day with the 76ers. After years of doing this, the routine came naturally, with the photos taking little time. That’s where LeBron delivered his first joke, but it was more than just a laugh. Sitting behind the table, he jokingly removed the nameplate in front of him, making it clear that everyone already knows who he is. The moment felt like a statement from a player who did not come to Philadelphia simply to play out the final years of his career. LeBron wants to compete for everything, and he appears ready to chase it all with the 76ers.
